case1.question: How do wage levels and employment differ across occupational AI exposure?
case1.note: Employment-weighted average of occupation medians, not the median wage of all workers. OEWS May 2025; nominal USD/year. Sampling covariance is unavailable; no inferential or causal claim is made.

aioe_display.interpretation: A 0--100 relative display scale derived from the signed, standardized AIOE values in this release. It preserves ordering; it is not a probability, replacement risk, or forecast of job loss.
